title.headline: 450 distributor agreements a year. One playbook.

end.line: Quillon for Tamsin Foods’ legal team

vo: Tamsin Foods’ legal team reviews about four hundred and fifty distributor agreements a year. Here is that work in Quillon.
In Word, Quillon redlines each distributor agreement to your playbook, with exclusivity set country by country.
When sales emails for a quick approval, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the clause.
Your exclusivity positions for each country are remembered, so every redline and reply starts from them.
Laura will walk your team through it on Monday the twenty-third.
